verdict.rationale: AMD provides official ROCm SDK documentation for the RX 9070 XT enabling development with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, and llama.cpp on both Windows and Linux, with an llms.txt confirming machine-readable docs availability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of SDK stability/completeness, and no evidence of API/openapi endpoints for programmatic integration.
